shards.range: Complete article: derivation, operation-count analysis, radix-2 implementation, application, timing results, and references (Mathematics of Computation, vol. 19, no. 90, journal pp. 297–301)
shards.note: The foundational Cooley–Tukey FFT paper is a short continuous derivation with no formal prose section headings; keeping it whole preserves the progression from composite factorization through the in-place binary algorithm and implementation results.

notes: The official AMS PDF was verified as a complete, unencrypted five-page article. Its physical pages correspond one-to-one with journal pages 297–301, using PDF page = journal page − 296. The article contains no numbered or titled prose sections, so the table of contents records the actual reading order by topic and equation blocks rather than inventing headings. The first page includes the title, authors, abstract, receipt date, and start of the derivation; the fifth page contains the end of the timing table, affiliations, and both cited references. At five pages it is kept as one shard.
